name: Dou shi chuan shuo wai mai pian
source:
You play as Yan, a delivery man working for a tea diner, who has a crush on a girl customer.

Day after day, you and the girl are getting to know each other better. Just when you think you may get lucky this time in love, the girl goes missing. You are devastated by her disappearance and determined to find out what has happened to her. But can you handle the truth? Do you really want to know the truth?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164860/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你扮演的是严，一名在茶餐厅工作的送货员，他暗恋着一位女顾客。

日复一日，你和女孩越来越了解彼此。就在你认为这次爱情可能会很幸运时，女孩却失踪了。你对她的失踪感到震惊，并决心查明她发生了什么事。但你能接受事实吗？你真的想知道真相吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164860/_/]Steam[/url]]
